name: Lindsey Stirling
milestone_by_age_26: Her music video 'Crystallize' became the 8th most-watched YouTube video of 2012 with over 42M views, and her self-released debut album 'Lindsey Stirling' launched in September 2012, selling 108K+ copies by mid-2013; she had 700K+ YouTube subscribers by August 2012 and a sold-out European tour.
early_history_summary: Stirling began violin at age 5 in a modest household in Gilbert, Arizona, with her parents only able to afford 15-minute lessons. She joined a rock band at 16, won Arizona's Junior Miss title, and appeared on America's Got Talent in 2010 at age 23. After AGT, she collaborated with cinematographer Devin Graham in 2011 to create YouTube music videos, rapidly building an audience through choreographed violin performances.
family_context_summary: Raised in a modest household in Gilbert, Arizona; parents Stephen and Diane Stirling had financial limitations, could only afford half violin lessons; father worked to support the family and died of cancer in 2017.
parent_family_domain_summary: Not documented in reviewed sources; no evidence of parental domain expertise in music or entertainment.

evidence_summary: Stirling grew up in a financially modest household in Gilbert, Arizona, where her parents could only afford 15-minute weekly violin lessons starting at age 5. She built deep violin skill through years of practice, joined a rock band in high school, and won Arizona's Junior Miss competition. After America's Got Talent in 2010, she leveraged YouTube as a distribution platform, collaborating with cinematographer Devin Graham to create viral music videos. Her unique choreographed violin performances filled a niche on YouTube, and 'Crystallize' becoming the 8th most-watched video of 2012 propelled her to mainstream success by age 25-26.
starting_point: Born to a modest household in Gilbert, Arizona; father Stephen and mother Diane raised three daughters with limited finances, affording only half violin lessons.
current_position: Active touring musician and YouTuber with 14.3M YouTube subscribers and 4.4B+ views; released album 'Duality' in 2024; resides in the US.
